title: Amaterasu
body:
Syntax: perform amaterasu <target>

Description: Mangekyo black flames burn a player until defeated; mobs take an initial 250 damage hit when the cast lands and continue burning afterward. The spell also ignites a separate room fire for five minutes. Surviving a fatal hit through Izanagi, an immortal safeguard, or a summon does not extinguish the player burn. There is no in-game sealing cure yet. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. The target must be in your room; moving away before a delayed cast resolves makes it fizzle. Costs 60 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 30 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
